Cornucopia is a reimagining of MizuJakkaru's [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/more-crops-mod-even-more-crops-mod-updated-20-04.111944/]More Crops Mod[/url], fully rewritten for Content Patcher on Stardew Valley 1.6. More Flowers has all the flowers you love from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2028]Mizu's Flowers[/url], with just as many brand new additions!

Cornucopia - More Flowers is also modular, offering two options for you to choose from. Whether you just want a few new flowers to spice up your game, or if you want to make the wildflower field of your dreams, we hope you'll love this mod.

If you're looking for some new fruits and vegetables, check out the sister mod, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia - More Crops[/url]!

If you love flower-themed playthroughs and wish there were more things to do with your flowers and honey, then take a look at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24842]Cornucopia - Artisan Machines[/url], which adds dried flowers, candles, essential oils, and more!
[center]
[img]https://imgur.com/QO3hCLy.png[/img][/center]
[list]
[*]40+ flower crops and 5 flower trees
[*]Flower bushes that can be planted and remain out of season, producing yearly when the weather is right.
[/list][i]
Bushes and planters act like vanilla teabushes, meaning they don't need watering, should be planted in untilled soil, and typically take a while to mature. Keep in mind that mod integration for Lookup Anything and Automate is not currently implemented, so please harvest your bushes by hand!

[/i][list]
[*]Toggles to enable crops and trees by user desires (See [url=https://github.com/MizuJakkaru/Cornucopia/blob/main/README.md#configuring-cornucopia][b]Configuring Cornucopia[/b][/url]﻿)
[/list][center]
[b][img]https://i.imgur.com/OGZGOGL.png[/img]﻿[/b][/center][b]
[/b]This is a brief overview of the configuration options included in this mod. We recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to configure your mod.

Cornucopia - More Flowers comes with an automatically-enabled set of [b]10 iconic flowers[/b], and an [b]additional set of 33 flowers and 5 flower trees[/b].

[b]Enable Extended Flowers Pack (Recommended):[/b] Set to [b]true[/b] to keep all additional flowers, set to [b]false[/b] to only use the essential 10 flowers.
[b]Rose Color Explosion:[/b] Gives each seasonal rose crop many possible colors.
[b]Enhanced Mixed Flower Seeds: [/b]With [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20357][b]Item Extensions[/b][/url], you can get Cornucopia flowers in Mixed Flower Seeds.
[b]Enable Giant Crops on Ginger Island:[/b] You need this to be [b]true[/b] to obtain giant Rafflesias!
[b]Enable Multicolored Flowers: [/b]Set to [b]true[/b] to let some flowers come in multiple colors like vanilla flowers, or [b]false[/b] if you want single colored fields.[i]Changing this config option will not affect existing plants, so it is recommended that you destroy and replant our flowers after changing it![/i]
[b]SVE Compat Patch: [/b]If Stardew Valley Expanded is installed, this makes both Rafflesias distinct in name and visuals.[center]
[b][img]https://imgur.com/Z3PY4Wr.png[/img][/b][b][/b][/center][b]
Q: Is Cornucopia a sequel to PPJA?
A  [/b]While some of our crops may be familiar to users of PPJA, both mods are actually based on [b][url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/mizus-sprites.136549/]MizuJakkaru's original sprites for SDV[/url][/b], back in the days of xnb modding. As such, there may be many differences in content, as they're two different spins on the same foundation. If you're interested in seeing what exactly is included, check out our [b][url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1dPEZ6ygmV9J66Z9Ry2wR4kq4m39aElR26XR_ElknawA/edit?usp=sharing]informational spreadsheet[/url][/b]!

[b]Q: Is Cornucopia compatible with [insert mod here]?
A: [/b]Thanks to improvements in mod compatibility over the years, Cornucopia is technically compatible with [i]any[/i] other mod, even those that add the same items. However, you may have different versions of the same crops if you have multiple large crop expansion mods.

[b]Q: Do I need to download all the Cornucopia mods?
A:[/b] Not at all! In fact, [i]any[/i] of the Cornucopia mods can be played with entirely by themselves. We do not have any required Cornucopia mods. If you like having more cooking recipes or machine goods, but you don't like having more crops, you are welcome to download just those mods!

[b]Q: Can I help out?
A: [/b][b]Yes. [/b]We always especially need help from translators and wiki contributors! But, you can also give
us feedback to improve our mods. Please leave a comment or [url=https://discord.gg/qEMWVcNPxe][b]join our Discord[/b][/url][b]. [/b]For questions and concerns over DMs, please contact 6480.
